posts.text: Steak out at the treat store

“Good morning. It’s Tuesday. Zoë went on a side mission this morning leaving me without protection against mean dogs. I was lucky there wasn’t an ambush. Zoë apparently saw a suspicious bunny and had to investigate.  Also, I love you.”
Just curious. How does this have 115 retweets and 6 views?

I don’t really get the controversy. Owners and publishers write op-eds. It was labeled as such.
